description: Import customs duty and tax rates for an HS code on a trade route (origin to destination country): MFN duty, preferential FTA rate, trade-remedy duties (anti-dumping, countervailing, Section 301), safeguard measures, import VAT or GST, special taxes, de minimis thresholds, and restrictions. For landed cost calculation, cross-border e-commerce, sourcing, and trade compliance. Cost: $0.35 USDC via x402.

hscode.description: Harmonized System (HS) code, 6-digit minimum (up to 10-digit national extensions)

language.description: Optional. Two-letter code for results in that language (default English): fr, de, it, es, ja, pt, zh, ar, nl, el, tr, ko, sv, vi, th, id. Same price in every language.

lookup.description: Destination (import) country name or ISO code

origin.description: Origin (export) country name or ISO code, for preferential FTA and trade-remedy rates. Optional but recommended.

name: interzoid_customs_duty_rates
